Variants.Content: Bitter Bridge is an important crossing bridge on the Mander River in the Reach, controlled by the Caswell family. It belongs to the jurisdiction of Highgarden, connecting the hinterland of the river bend, the direction of King's Landing and the Dorne border; bridges, river transport and surrounding markets make it not only a resting place for merchants, but also a key point for armies to compete for food routes.

Entry Bitterbridge Local families also rely on wells, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and travel to avoid the hot sun; if any road, well, or dock fails, the cost falls first on them.

Entry Bitterbridge They also recognize Dornish accents, laws and credentials; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar or horse's hoof.

Entry Bitterbridge If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

Craftsmen use their hands to measure the boats, bridge timbers, millstones, fishing nets and riverside sanctuaries of Bitterbridge. Priests use rituals to continue the common memory of the Seven Gods, the legacy of Rhoynar and the different bloodlines under the prince's rule. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Bitterbridge They care about wells and springs, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and routes to avoid the scorching sun. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
